title: Den plugin (den.plugin/v1)
description: A plugin for a Den distribution: one or more extension points (provides) and the capabilities it needs. Kept as den-plugin.json in plugins/<id>/, either the distribution's own (local) or vendored by `<cli> plugin add <git url>[/<subpath>]@<ref>` (added, pinned in plugins.lock.json). A directory holding only a den-theme.json is an implicit theme plugin. v1 only ever gains optional fields; a rename or removal is v2.

id.description: Stable identifier, the name of its plugins/<id>/ directory: 2–40 characters, lowercase letters, digits or dashes, starting with a letter. Not "den".

version.description: The plugin's own semver. Tag the repo with it (v1.2.0, or <id>/v1.2.0 in a repo of several plugins).

license.description: SPDX license expression for the plugin, the same rule as a theme's (den.theme/v1). Bundled fonts carry their own.

den.description: Den versions this plugin supports, as a semver range (">=0.3.0 <0.4.0"). Required.

maintainer.description: Who answers for it: a person or a team (admission rule 1).

readme.description: The README that says its tier, what it may touch and what it must never do (admission rule 2). Default README.md. Files-tier plugins are exempt.

provides.description: One entry per extension point. Each kind defines its entry's fields.

capabilities.description: What it may touch, from a closed vocabulary. A local plugin's declared set is its approved set; an added plugin's is approved at add and recorded in plugins.lock.json.

path.description: A file inside the plugin's directory: relative, no '..'.

kind.description: files tier: theme, catalog, persona-pack. browser tier: page. server tier: mcp-tools, work-items, runtime, session-backend, notifier, secrets, identity, health-source, usage.

manifest.description: The theme's den-theme.json (den.theme/v1), inside the plugin.

entry.description: The page's ES module, inside the plugin.

label.description: A catalog key or the text itself.

capability.description: ui.nav, api.read, api.actions:<id,...>, secrets:<ref,...>, net:<host,...>, exec:<binary,...> or send:<channel>.
